Air Conditioning

We help people with all of their air conditioning installation, repair, and maintenance needs needs by making sure their air conditioning systems are running safely, reliably and efficiently.

Heat Pumps & Ductless

Looking for highly efficient year-round comfort, all in one unit? Heat pumps and ductless systems offer just that, and we can professionally install them for you promptly.

Wine Cellar Cooling

Whether you want to upgrade your current wine cellar cooling system, or install a brand-new one in your home, GRC Mechanical is pleased to offer professional wine cellar cooling services.

Other Services

As a full-service HVAC/R company, you can count on GRC Mechanical for all your comfort needs, including generator installation and services, piping, and indoor air quality products.

Commercial HVAC & Refrigeration

We’re pleased to meet the HVAC/R needs of businesses and organizations in Bergen County, NJ, Rockland County, NY and surrounding areas. Our skilled commercial HVAC/R professionals will help meet your needs promptly, with your budget in mind.

"courteous and helpful."

- Wendy P.

Would highly recommend to anyone with a Generator!"
 
- Diane Z.

"GRC folks are knowledgeable in how heating and air conditioning systems work. They have both done excellent work on my home heating system and will start on setting up my OLD A/C system next week for the summer season. - Werner M.

About GRC Mechanical Services

4.8

Review Score as of 1/19/24

GRC Mechanical Services was established in 1948 as a refrigeration service organization. Today, we are a full-service HVAC/R mechanical contractor with many long-time and loyal commercial and residential clients. We think that fact speaks to the uncompromising quality of our work. GRC Mechanical Services is owned and operated by two professional engineers who are cousins, Fred G. Russenberger, Jr., PE. and John P. Russenberger, PE.

GRC Mechanical is a 6-Time Winner of the Carrier® President’s Award.

President’s Awards are presented annually to an elite group of Carrier dealers who exemplify the company’s model for operational excellence, business effectiveness and delivering the best in cutting-edge technology to consumers. Carrier also awards dealers who are committed to providing excellent customer service and who are dedicated to the Carrier brand. Winners go above and beyond the call of duty in the industry with a dependable, customer-focused work ethic.

Learn More About Our Service, Engineering, & Installation Departments

Through our Service Department, we provide technical solutions that promote a relationship and instill confidence with our clients. This is the foundation for the Engineering Department's design-build services. Eighty percent of our installation work comes from our existing clients for whom we design the entire system or are called upon to comment on their existing design. Our Installation Department will then utilize its duct fabrication and installation, rigging, pipe fitting, plumbing, and control wiring capabilities to complete the task.

Licenses & Affiliations

Professional Organizations

American Society of Heating, Refrigerating, and Air-Conditioning Engineers
Air Conditioning Contractors Of America
North American Technician Excellence

Licenses

NJ HVACR License: 19HC00091600
Rockland County Mechanical Contractor License: P-1633
Professional Engineering Licenses: 40297,  29109
Plumbing License: 12650
At GRC Mechanical Services, we work hard for our commercial and residential customers.

We always strive to provide our customers with the information they need. Learn more about the ways we can serve you below:

Breathe Easy Maintenance Plan: A comprehensive maintenance plan designed to help improve your comfort as well as your system’s efficiency.
Financing: Need help paying for your heating and cooling needs? Learn more about our special financing.
Special Offers: For sales and specials on our products and services, visit our Special Offers page often.
Careers: Considering a career in the HVAC industry? We may have just the opportunity you’re looking for!

Contact Us: Touch base with us - visit this page for contact information.
